headline: Sample post: how a GST circular update will look
summary_points: This is placeholder content to preview the layout. It is not a real update.
Real posts list 3–5 key points drawn only from the official text.
Notification numbers, dates and rates are never guessed — blank if unknown.
Sample posts are removed automatically on the first live run.
who_is_affected: Shown here in real posts: the taxpayers or entities this applies to.
action_required: Shown here in real posts: what the reader should do next.

social.linkedin: Sample LinkedIn caption. Real posts get a 120–200 word professional write-up generated from the official source, ending with a reminder to verify with the source.
social.x: Sample X caption (under 260 characters) with a link back to the post.
